data.completion_memo: Implemented the pinned Management repair review and production native persistence. The UI projects all recurring-error groups, investigation state, exact group-scoped candidate ID/version, independent diff/tests/benchmark/consequence/uncertainty/rollback/authority evidence states, explicit none/not-performed/unavailable/corrupt states, and Supported/EnrollmentRequired/Unsupported gates without fabricating bytes or verification. Activation requires a fresh exact capability digest and explicit confirmation; stale versions, incomplete disclosure, unavailable artifacts, missing authority context, and absent privileged ports remain disabled. Keyboard navigation, focus-trapped confirmation, tooltips, disclosure selection, and accessibility coverage match the mockup. The Tauri adapter atomically persists/reopens multi-group core events in OS app data, validates global/group sequences, rejects mixed snapshots and cross-group stale replay, and safely redrives lost accepted receipts while bootstrap/investigation/checkpoint/quiescence/artifact ports stay explicitly unavailable. Strict native tests passed 18/18, Management UI 23/23, TypeScript and Vite passed; Adashi QA job 10 run 28 passed.
data.description: Implement the pinned Management Chat scope, recurring-error ledger, investigation progress, evidence selection, and complete repair-candidate review with exact diff, tests, benchmarks, consequences, uncertainty, rollback point, activation eligibility, and stale-version gates. Activation remains disabled unless a fresh core-projected Supported report and explicit user decision exist.
data.title: M10.4 — Implement Management repair review
